items.criterion: The submission is a single Excel workbook file.
items.evidence: Single file: RPO_CBA_Compensation_Model.xlsx

items.criterion: Workbook contains at least one dedicated Calculations sheet separate from Inputs and Summary.
items.evidence: Sheet 'Employee Calc': 'One row per musician per quarter per year.'

items.criterion: Workbook contains a Summary for the current calendar year showing compensation expense by type and by quarter.
items.evidence: Dashboard A12 'Current calendar year expense by compensation type' with Q1–Q4 columns

items.criterion: The current calendar year Summary includes four distinct quarters of the current calendar year.

The compensation type list shown on the Summary exactly matches the compensation types defined in the Assumptions tab of the reference file 'Orchestra assumptions and roster.xlsx' (no extra or missing types).
items.evidence: Types: Minimum Weekly Scale, Overscale, Titled Positions / Principal Pay, Media Exploitation Fee, Seniority Pay, Payroll Tax

items.criterion: Each Calculation detail is assigned to a specific quarter of the current calendar year, used for quarterly roll‑ups.
items.evidence: Employee Calc column B 'Quarter' (B6=1, B7=2...) used in SUMIFS

items.criterion: For each compensation type on the current calendar year Summary, the annual total equals the sum of all four quarters of the current calendar year for that type.
For each current calendar year quarter, the Summary grand total equals the sum of all compensation types for that quarter.
The current calendar year annual grand total on the Summary equals the sum of the four quarterly grand totals.
All current calendar year Summary totals are formula‑driven and derive from Calculation sheets (no hard‑coded results).

items.criterion: Workbook contains a projections summary by quarter for current calendar year +2 using the same compensation type list as current calendar year.

items.criterion: Current calendar year + 1 projection summary totals are formula‑driven from inputs/calculations (no hard‑coded totals).
